title: The Twits
author: Roald Dahl
level: Middle school. English meanings in simple words.

sight.meaning: Something that you see, especially something strange or beautiful.
sight.whyHard: This word has more than one meaning.

senses.meaning: Something that you see, especially something strange or beautiful.
To “catch sight of” something means to see it suddenly.

anchors.context: he caught sight of Mrs Twit’s awful glass eye staring up at him

senses.meaning: “Out of sight” means hidden, or too far away to be seen.

anchors.context: sunk out of sight in the fatty folds of his flabby neck
